claims: TSA agents are expected to start receiving back pay and compensation starting Monday, March 30, 2026.
President Trump ordered the use of existing funds to pay employees during the ongoing government shutdown.
Back pay for missed paychecks is currently being processed.
The Administration is using funds from previous funding legislation to compensate the roughly 61,000 TSA employees.
Employees are seeing back pay for missed March paychecks.
Some employees expressed concern about whether this covers all time owed.
Workers are concerned about future paychecks.
The move was intended to alleviate massive travel delays and worker shortages caused by employees working without pay since February.
